About TensorWave

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Data Hall Design Engineer to join our team during an exciting phase of growth. Data Hall Design defines every data hall before it is built: layouts, power, liquid cooling and white space for high-density GPU clusters. As a Data Hall Design Engineer, you own design packages that Build turns into live capacity. Your work has to be right, buildable and on time, because the go-live date depends on it.

What You’ll Do

  • Produce and own data hall design packages: hall layouts, rack elevations, electrical one-lines, power distribution, cooling P&IDs and white space plans.

  • Design for high-density GPU racks, including liquid cooling (CDUs, manifolds, direct-to-chip and rear door heat exchangers) and MV/LV power distribution.

  • Run load, cooling and coordination calculations; check designs against NEC, NFPA and ASHRAE.

  • Apply the standard data hall design and document site-specific deltas for review.

  • Write and review scopes of work and bills of material for Build, Procurement and GCs.

  • Direct A/E consultants and vendors; review their drawings, calcs and submittals.

  • Answer RFIs from the field quickly and fold field changes back into the design.

  • Coordinate layouts and pathways with Network Engineering, Build, Operations and AMD.

  • Capture lessons learned after each site and improve the standard design.

Scope

  • Owns a defined package (one system in one hall) with review

  • Owns a full discipline for a hall from basis of design through IFC

Technical Depth

  • Working knowledge of one discipline (electrical or mechanical) and the relevant codes

  • Deep knowledge of one discipline and working knowledge of adjacent ones

Influence

  • Works with Build, consultants and vendors on own package

  • Represents the discipline in design reviews; directs A/E consultants; mentors others

 

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • 5 to 9 years, including data center design delivered through construction

  • Licensure

    • EIT or working toward PE

    • PE eligible or licensed preferred

  • Degree in electrical, mechanical or architectural engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • Proficient in AutoCAD and Revit; comfortable with BIM coordination.

  • Able to read and produce one-lines, P&IDs, floor plans and rack elevations.

  • Working knowledge of power distribution (switchgear, UPS, busway, PDUs) or cooling systems (CRAH, CDU, chilled water).

  • Clear written communication; organized and detail oriented.

Preferred Qualifications

  • High-density or liquid-cooled GPU or HPC data hall design (30 kW+ per rack).

  • CFD review experience.

  • Experience with hyperscale or neocloud standard designs and prefab or modular systems.

  • Field or construction experience on data center projects.

What We Offer

  • Stock Options

  • 100% paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance for Employees

  • Company Health Savings Account Contributions

  • 100% paid Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance for Employees

  • Life and Voluntary Supplemental Insurance Options

  • Other Insurance Options, such as Pet & Legal Insurance

  • Various Supplementary Health Benefits, such as discounted Virtual Healthcare Appointments and Serious Illness Support

  • Flexible Spending Account

  • 401(k)

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Flexible PTO

  • Paid Holidays

  • Parental Leave

  • Other In-Office Perks

Equal Employment Opportunity

TensorWave is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under applicable law.

Reasonable Accommodations

TensorWave provides reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact accomodations@tensorwave.com.

Employment Eligibility

All offers of employment are contingent upon verification of identity and authorization to work in the United States, as required by law.

Background Checks

Where permitted by law, employment may be contingent upon the successful completion of a job-related background check.

Data Privacy Notice

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that TensorWave may collect, use, and retain your personal information for recruiting and employment-related purposes in accordance with applicable data privacy laws.
